title: Pounded Yam
description: Pounded Yam is a Nigeria classic prepared with yam. A measured home-style version, with ingredients assigned to the cooking steps where they are used. Use true yam tubers; plantain, sweet potato and ordinary potatoes are not equivalent substitutes.

steps.instruction: Wash and prepare the listed produce; dice or chop evenly for a consistent texture.
Cook the listed ingredients in simmering water for about 28 minutes until tender; drain well if necessary.
Pound hot, drained yam repeatedly until the pieces disappear and the mixture becomes stretchy and glossy; do not add flour or oil.
Finish with the listed ingredients, check seasoning and serve immediately.
